name: Roll in the Dark (Optimized)
author: kul0tz
description: This is the optimized build for the WebGL version. My rendition of the Roll-a-ball tutorial from Unity Learn. I was dead set to create my own game and this is the first tutorial that I learn from Unity Learn website. I finished the tutorial and wasn't satisfied to what I've done, so I refined it and this is what I've got.
